resources.string: Share of tiles in the selected group
Selected tiles = starting tally × (selected percentage ÷ 100). Remaining tiles = starting tally minus selected tiles.

In the thymus, positive selection helps thymocytes that express both CD4 and CD8 survive and develop toward a CD4+ or CD8+ lineage. Negative selection removes many self-reactive thymocytes. Conventional CD4+ T cells can later take on helper functions, and conventional CD8+ T cells can take on cytotoxic functions. Thymus-derived regulatory T cells also arise from developing CD4+ cells but are distinct from conventional helper T cells. The exercise divides an invented tally of tiles into two groups. Neither group represents a real stage, lineage, or fate. The numbers are not biological measurements or estimates for anyone.
